scope: Selected production configuration numeric leaves and literal top-level constants. Counts are audit records, not independent degrees of freedom, evidence quality scores or percentages of the model calibrated. Unresolved code expressions and unreviewed coefficients remain explicit; function-body constants are outside this first inventory.

components.label: Climate physics
components.validation: Earth-tested r43; dev49 and finer-grid checks; sealed e was scored and is spent. All unchanged coefficients are not automatically reclassified as fitted here.
components.observables: Monthly temperature, rain amount/seasonality, SST; process budgets and resolution transfer.
components.next_test: Audit remaining shared physics versus world-geometry fields; future heldout tests must respect the existing exposure ledger.

components.label: Crop production, area and calendars
components.validation: Some historical aggregate fitting; crop physiological-clock candidate failed its evaluation. Modern/potential yield grids are not independent ancient observations.
components.observables: Crop yield, cultivated area, dates and water response, separated by management and period.
components.next_test: Fit process responses with observed climate and independent land/yield records before refitting population.

components.label: Soil water, runoff and seasonality
components.validation: Simplified buckets and selected regional checks; no comprehensive discharge or soil-storage calibration demonstrated.
components.observables: ET, seasonal soil moisture, streamflow, snow and low flows.
components.next_test: Compare water budgets and discharge on Earth; separate measured soil heterogeneity from effective fitted storage.

components.label: Vegetation, forage and water access
components.validation: Miami productivity and inherited allocation assumptions; seasonal proxy/resource circuits are not calibrated herd populations.
components.observables: NPP, forage seasonality, energy/protein, sustainable intake and water permanence.
components.next_test: Validate annual and lean-season resources before estimating animal products or mobile communities.

components.label: Foraging physiology and resource adaptation
components.validation: Adapted kernel has continent-separated Binford tests; adopted aquatic calibration improves heldout error, with regional failures and later rejected variants.
components.observables: Density, diet shares and procurement time; population dynamics and food balance.
components.next_test: Keep geographic transfer tests; obtain independent prey/plant/fishing resource observations rather than fitting density alone.

components.label: Malaria and ecological population modifiers
components.validation: Thermal trait equations are sourced; moisture gate and density penalty lack independent epidemiological/demographic calibration.
components.observables: Vector/parasite responses, transmission season; separately illness, mortality and work loss.
components.next_test: Validate suitability against appropriate pre-control data before fitting demographic effects.

components.label: Population allocation and livability
components.validation: Historical analogue occupancies and HYDE/Han comparisons; scenario allocation is not an independent census forecast.
components.observables: Absolute people and spatial allocation, with urban/rural distinction and recorded uncertainty.
components.next_test: Use direct censuses/surveys as anchors; distinguish independently measured counts from HYDE imputation.

components.label: Travel and freight
components.validation: Selected Earth comparisons and published/assumed rates; old market-access town-size test failed. ORBIS is a model comparator, not independent journey observations.
components.observables: Observed travel duration, mode, cargo, monetary costs and seasonal restrictions.
components.next_test: Fit transport to journeys/freight evidence before fitting trade outcomes; retain rejected scale identification.

unresolved_expressions.name: NEIGHBOURS
unresolved_expressions.expression: [(a, b) for a in (-1, 0, 1) for b in (-1, 0, 1) if a or b]

components.label: Settlement sites and administrative seats
components.validation: Seat-count/spacing and dry-site rules have Earth fits and later-era checks. These are not all-village or urban-size models.
components.observables: Seat counts, site locations and independently estimated settlement size.
components.next_test: Validate types separately; stop using served people as measured town residents.

components.label: Shared grain, residents and sustained reach
components.validation: Conserved ledgers and sensitivity tests; cohort/request/storage/collection assumptions have not been empirically fitted.
components.observables: Rural meals, stored grain, marketed supply, supported residents, documented institutional presence and access.
components.next_test: Independent rural household/land/work evidence, then storage/imports and institution records. Never infer de facto control from painted claims used as inputs.

components.label: Shared rural workforce and listed field tasks
components.validation: Normative Columella task counts plus uncalibrated workforce/time budgets. Food-derived reference workers are not observed residents.
components.observables: Reported task hours, cultivated hectares, household members and labour sources.
components.next_test: VDSA manual-reaping benchmark with independent household size; modern evidence is not automatic AD200 transfer.
